senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. גַּרְגַּר)to form globules, to drop. Denom. גַּרְעִין.
(denom. of גרעין) to form globules (one of the early stages of development of the grape).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:10">Shebi. IV, 10</cite> <he>גפנים מִשֶּׁיְּגָרְעוּ</he> grape vines (must not be cut down in the Sabbath year) from the moment they form stones, Maim.; oth. opin. ovules containing moisture; Y. ib. IV, end 35ᶜ <he>משיַגְרִיעוּ</he> (Hif.), defined <he>משיזחלו מים</he>, with ref. to <cite ref="Job 36:27">Job XXXVI, 27</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 63b">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 52b">Pes. 52ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>משיגריעו</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>משיגרעו</he>).
